players.product: Copper surface-treatment / plating chemicals for package substrates (Samsung Electro-Mechanics supplier)

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 (January-December 2025) results (annual securities report): net sales JPY 20,947,752 thousand (+14.9%), a record high, of which chemicals JPY 20,211,797 thousand (+15.6%); gross profit JPY 12,977,222 thousand, gross margin 62.0% (+1.1 points); operating income JPY 5,748,013 thousand (+26.0%), operating margin 27.4% versus 25.0% the prior year; ordinary income JPY 6,051,506 thousand (+29.2%); profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 5,028,609 thousand (+119.4%). Management attributes the sales growth to steady demand for chemicals for advanced semiconductor package substrates, mainly generative-AI related, and for general-purpose package substrates for PCs and smartphones, and the profit growth to higher chemical shipment volumes and steady demand for high-margin products. Overseas sales ratio 65.1% (61.7% the prior year); including sales to overseas customers through domestic Japanese agents, 80.3% (77.3%).
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 net sales JPY 20,947,752 thousand (+14.9%); operating income JPY 5,748,013 thousand (+26.0%); operating margin 27.4%

quarterly_data.signal: Products (annual securities report, FY2025): MEC's chemicals are mainly metal surface-treatment agents and account for more than 90% of both sales and operating income. The company states its chemicals hold a high share in manufacturing semiconductor package substrates for computers and COF substrates for displays; its CZ series adhesion promoter roughens the copper surface so copper and resin do not delaminate under chip heat, and is adopted by semiconductor package substrate makers worldwide; it is also developing a chemical-adhesion technology that improves copper-resin adhesion without roughening. In FY2025 the CZ series (ultra-roughening adhesion promoter with a high share in package substrates) performed strongly on generative-AI, PC and smartphone demand; the V-Bond series (multilayer boards) and EXE series (displays) were roughly flat; the SF series (displays) declined. Management expects growth in the number of semiconductor package substrates on strong semiconductor demand, and larger, higher-layer-count substrates for higher performance, to drive demand for the CZ series and for products for leading-edge technology.
quarterly_data.figure: Chemicals more than 90% of sales and operating income

quarterly_data.signal: Segments, FY2025 (annual securities report; sales to external customers): Japan JPY 7,827,186 thousand (+8.6%), segment profit JPY 4,301,885 thousand (+23.7%) - demand for products for advanced package substrates, mainly generative-AI related, kept expanding, and sales to Korea through Japanese agents were firm on the recovery in memory package substrates; Taiwan JPY 3,887,138 thousand (+16.9%), led by advanced (generative-AI) and general-purpose (PC, smartphone) package substrates; Zhuhai (China) JPY 2,780,493 thousand (+20.6%) on generative-AI, smartphone and PC demand; Suzhou (China) JPY 3,953,110 thousand (+9.9%) on smartphone, PC and display demand; Europe JPY 1,393,086 thousand (+40.8%) - demand varied by customer, but the region moved out of inventory adjustment, plus temporary demand for materials it handles; Thailand JPY 1,106,736 thousand (+36.5%) - automotive was weak but satellite-communication products and package-substrate demand were firm as board makers step up capex in Southeast Asia. Production (manufacturing cost of electronic-substrate chemicals) totalled JPY 11,069,849 thousand (+16.1%). Orders received are not disclosed because the company mainly produces to forecast, and no customer accounted for 10% or more of net sales.

quarterly_data.signal: Medium-term management plan '2030 Vision Phase 2' (FY ending December 2025 to FY ending December 2027) targets, as stated in the annual securities report: consolidated net sales of JPY 250 hundred million in the fiscal year ending December 2027, operating margin 26-30%, consolidated ROE 13-16%; R&D investment of about 10% of consolidated net sales every year; capital expenditure of about JPY 80 hundred million cumulative over the three years. The company refers to its February 13, 2026 update of the plan's numerical targets.

JPY 4,700,000 thousand (JPY 2,897,801 thousand already paid), started March 2023, completion planned December 2026, to strengthen the production system; Nagaoka Factory manufacturing equipment of JPY 250,000 thousand and JPY 130,000 thousand (March-December 2026, capacity increase); Amagasaki site test equipment (two items of JPY 60,000 thousand, development capability) and manufacturing equipment of JPY 50,000 thousand (July-August 2026, capacity increase); subsidiaries' manufacturing / environmental equipment in 2026 - Taiwan JPY 190,116 thousand, Suzhou JPY 82,412 thousand, Zhuhai JPY 56,719 thousand, Europe JPY 104,507 thousand, Thailand JPY 15,645 thousand.

quarterly_data.signal: R&D (annual securities report, FY2025): R&D expenses JPY 1,379 million, all at the parent; about 30% of the parent's 292 employees work in R&D, 90 of them on chemical development, in groups for existing-product improvement, new areas, wiring-pattern formation chemicals and metal-resin bonding technology, plus a group for machines / automatic analyzers for the chemicals. Development focuses on chemicals for electronic substrates requiring high density, high frequency, low signal loss (low latency), high reliability and power saving for IoT, AI and autonomous driving, and on substrate and display chemicals for high-function devices.
